answer_obj.answer: The root_path attribute of the scope is not being set correctly. This is because the proxy server is serving the app under /api, and the sub-app is mounted at /v2. When request.url_for() is called in the sub-app, it does not include the /api prefix because the root_path attribute of the scope is not being set to the full URL of the proxy server. To fix this, you need to set the root_path attribute of the scope to the full URL of the proxy server, like this: scope['app_root_path'] = '/api'.
